Troll_Idle.prompt: A large heavy person stands hunched forward with the head low and long arms hanging in front, breathing heavily, shoulders rising and falling.

Troll_Walk.prompt: A heavy person hunched forward walks with slow stomping steps, head low, long arms hanging in front and swinging.

Troll_Smash.prompt: A person hunched forward slowly raises both arms high above the head with the hands together, then smashes them down hard onto the ground in front, bending forward.

Troll_Sweep.prompt: A person hunched forward pulls the right arm back and swings it in a wide horizontal arc from right to left in front of the body.

Troll_Hit.prompt: A person hunched forward is hit hard in the chest, staggers backward two steps with the arms in front, then recovers.

Troll_Roar.prompt: A person hunched forward spreads both arms wide in front and roars, head pushed forward.
